producer_report.summary: "try again on <job>" now accepts jobs closed as failed (such as those refused at admission) as well as rejected ones. The recorded outcome reason is carried into the reader's "Earlier attempt" section, redacted, and the section says "failed" or "was rejected" to match the job's actual state. In reading.rs, earlier_attempt accepts Failed, and other states are refused with "only a rejected or failed job can be tried again". The "no verification record" bail is gone. It now bails only if a job has neither a verification nor an outcome. carry adds "outcome: <reason>" for failed jobs and for any job with no verification. EarlierAttempt in briefs.rs gains a `failed` flag. The brief's wording changed from "The verification recorded no findings" to "The job recorded no findings", and the findings intro now covers the outcome reason. Unit tests in reading.rs and briefs.rs, a lifecycle test (a job refused at admission for a governance file, then retried), CHANGELOG and README are updated. cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy pass clean, and the full cargo test passes.

checks_run.note: Includes the new lifecycle test and the unit tests in reading.rs and briefs.rs.

open_issues: The deliverables list named run.rs and manage.rs, but neither needed a change, so they are untouched.
Referenced jobs, which also use carry, now include the outcome reason for failed or unverified jobs. Their section format is unchanged apart from that extra line.
mistakes: My first non-retryable-state unit test expected 'proposed' for a hand-built job, but it is 'queued'. I fixed the test.
learnings: A job with no readings or dispatch is in the queued state, so a hand-built JobRecords with only a request reports 'queued'.
Admission failures are recorded as OutcomeState::Failed with the reason 'admission refused the change: ...', and have no verification record.
The lifecycle test for a governance-file change (rustfmt.toml edit) is a ready way to make a job fail at admission.
